context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5.8 Live Readiness Control System fully verified. Key features: (1) Position Sync Engine compares engine_positions with exchange_positions, emits POSITION_DRIFT_DETECTED on field mismatches (position_size, entry_price, leverage, unrealized_pnl), states: SYNCED/DRIFT/UNVERIFIED, (2) Order Reconciliation Engine checks engine_orders vs exchange_orders for MISSING_ORDER, DUPLICATE_ORDER, EXECUTION_MISMATCH on fields (symbol, side, price, quantity, status), emits ORDER_RECONCILIATION_ERROR, states: RECONCILED/ERROR/UNVERIFIED, (3) Balance Integrity Guard validates wallet_balance, available_balance, used_margin between engine and exchange, emits BALANCE_INTEGRITY_ALERT, states: INTACT/ALERT/UNVERIFIED, (4) Exchange Latency Guard monitors order_ack_latency (>1200ms), api_response_latency (>1000ms), websocket_delay (>800ms), heartbeat_gap (>20s), emits EXCHANGE_LATENCY_ALERT with trade_frequency_throttle and order_submission_delay actions, states: NORMAL/ELEVATED/ALERT, (5) Readiness Score Engine uses equal weights 0.25 for all 4 components, score thresholds <70=BLOCKED, 70-84=WARNING, >=85=READY, (6) Live Readiness Guard enforces pipeline: BLOCKED->BLOCK action (reject_trade=true, pause_engine=true, size_multiplier=0, LIVE_READINESS_BLOCK event), WARNING->DOWNSHIFT action (size_multiplier=0.7), READY->ALLOW action (size_multiplier=1.0), (7) Live Readiness Audit builds event list from all component events. Frontend page at /admin/futures/live-readiness with data-testid=nav-admin-futures-live-readiness-link. UI shows: readiness score (66.25), state (BLOCKED), active alerts (2), guard action (BLOCK), position sync monitor, order reconciliation monitor, balance integrity monitor, exchange latency chart, active alerts list. Integration verified with strategy pipeline via apply_live_readiness_guard_to_decisions function. All 8 regression endpoints verified working.
